clips.title: The story
paras: In east-central Ashenvale, Night Run crowns a cliff-ringed bluff among the ancient elven ruins. Felmusk satyr dwell there, and dark soul magic gathers within the outpost.

Night Run is Ashenvale’s smallest and most isolated of its three major satyr strongholds, alongside Xavian and Satyrnaar. Crumbling elven stonework and broken pillars shelter the settlement on a high ridge bounded by steep, impassable cliffs. Travelers can reach it by following the Falfarren River near the waters of Xavian, then turning west up the ridge, or by taking a precarious northern ledge above Raynewood Retreat. Though small, the enclave is dangerous. The Felmusk satyr work with the shadowy Cult of the Dark Strand, anchoring twisted soulgems to gather demonic essence within the forest.
